findings_resolved.original_risk: Post-commit path stat could adopt a replacement file as owned, return success for foreign bytes, or remove it during cancellation cleanup.
findings_resolved.resolution: Commit retains original staging identity; publication verifies returned identities and reads back final GLB and metadata bytes; cleanup keeps foreign replacement inodes.

findings_resolved.original_risk: Legal existing collection names with spaces were rejected after worker completion.
findings_resolved.resolution: Safe single-component collection names preserve spaces while confinement, alias, device and forbidden-character guards remain.

findings_resolved.original_risk: Async task cancellation was outside the terminal result lock and could race the done transition.
findings_resolved.resolution: Async cancellation shares the terminal commit lock and changes cancellation state only for pending or running jobs.
Original staging ownership is captured from open file descriptors with os.fstat before close, rather than a replaceable path stat.

other_verification.combined_suite_timing: Before final staging fstat correction; affected 18-test core suite independently rerun on final reviewed hash.
other_verification.earlier_reviewer_environment_issue: A combined attempt with PATH Python passed 17 then-current core tests but could not import four route modules because that interpreter lacked FastAPI; final core verification used the pinned API interpreter.

root_reported_skips.reason: POSIX mode-bit enforcement is not applicable on Windows

other_verification.skip_description_correction: Only the symlink test is a privilege skip; original reviewed source pins and test timing remain unchanged.

trust_boundary_observations: Authority is a trusted host-only object; worker descriptor cannot supply authority or substitute an ordinary output Path.
Receipt, four proof pins, worker source pin, image, parameter, model, job and fresh request context are checked before publication.
Generated mode requires current proof context and freshness; historical proof acceptance requires explicit replay mode.
Publication copies and verifies source bytes, publishes provenance before the GLB, rejects existing destinations and preserves foreign replacements during cleanup.
Result URL and terminal done state are assigned only after successful authenticated promotion and a serialized cancellation check.
No installed worker manifest or ordinary Generate option gains the completion capability in this source change.
replay_harness_observations: Uses an unregistered explicit replay adapter, actual generation API routes, and the production host completion receiver and authenticator.
Substitutes only the adapter send operation with a clearly labelled saved worker reply; master uses four pinned historical receipts and tiny transport control uses explicit synthetic test receipts.
Checks the original image hash, both source GLB hashes, exact output bytes, replay provenance and post-exit full-file readback.
Checks resource admission before attempt marker; one owned CPU worker receives GO only after Job attachment; process and Job limits are 6 GiB with a 180-second deadline.
Owned process-tree cleanup is verified and forced cleanup prevents PASS.
limits: Review supports the bounded CPU replay/integration test; it does not establish fresh AMD image inference.
Replay harness does not exercise a real extension producer through stdio or render the result in the viewer.
No GPU, model weights, or installed application was launched during this independent review.
